notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
description:
Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {G} and discarding a land card.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to mill four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Circle of the Land Druid, adding {G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
